description: Unit test class for the CalendarSync component, including singleton pattern validation, error handling, and business logic verification within the SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: CalendarSyncTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the CalendarSync functionality, covering singleton pattern, error handling, system integration, and business logic adherence.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by obtaining the singleton instance of CalendarSync before each test.

methods.name: testGetInstance
methods.description: Verifies that CalendarSync's singleton pattern returns the same instance each time.

methods.name: testSingletonCannotBeCloned
methods.description: Ensures that the singleton cannot be cloned, maintaining instance integrity.

methods.name: testSingletonCannotBeUnserialized
methods.description: Ensures that deserializing a singleton instance throws an exception to prevent multiple instances.

methods.name: testSyncAllCalendarAccountsReturnsTrue
methods.description: Checks that the syncAllCalendarAccounts method returns a boolean value.

methods.name: testGetCalendarSourceTypes
methods.description: Tests that getCalendarSourceTypes returns an array, indicating proper registry retrieval.

methods.name: testGetConfig
methods.description: Validates that getConfig returns an array, confirming configuration data retrieval.

methods.name: testGetConflictResolutionCases
methods.description: Verifies that getConflictResolutionCases returns an array, confirming enum integration.

methods.name: testGetScheduler
methods.description: Checks that getScheduler returns either null or a Scheduler object, confirming scheduler retrieval.

methods.name: testSyncEventWithInvalidData
methods.description: Ensures syncEvent handles invalid JSON data gracefully by returning false.

methods.name: testGetProviderAuthMethodWithValidationWithEmptySource
methods.description: Validates error handling when an empty provider source is validated.

methods.name: testGetProviderAuthMethodWithValidationWithValidSource
methods.description: Checks error handling for unconfigured provider sources.

methods.name: testTestProviderConnectionWithValidationWithEmptySource
methods.description: Ensures that testing provider connection with an empty source throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetFieldsToHideWithValidSource
methods.description: Validates business rule for OAuth2 source to hide specific fields.

methods.name: testGetFieldsToHideWithBasicAuth
methods.description: Validates business rule for basic auth source to hide specific fields.

methods.name: testGetFieldsToHideWithUnknownSource
methods.description: Checks that all auth fields are hidden for unknown provider sources as a security fallback.

methods.name: testSaveConfigWithValidData
methods.description: Verifies only valid configuration keys are saved, ignoring invalid ones.

methods.name: testGetActiveCalendarAccountsForUserWithEmptyUserId
methods.description: Ensures an empty user ID yields an empty accounts array.

methods.name: testGetActiveCalendarAccountsForUserWithValidUserId
methods.description: Checks that a valid user ID retrieves associated calendar accounts.

methods.name: testSyncEventWithValidData
methods.description: Verifies that valid event data triggers a boolean sync operation.

methods.name: testSyncMeetingWithDeletedMeeting
methods.description: Ensures deleted meetings are handled without errors during sync.

methods.name: testSyncMeetingWithNoAssignedUser
methods.description: Validates that meetings without assigned users are gracefully skipped.
